Description: 
 Software Language & Tools Required:  
 Experience working on a big data platform 
 Demonstrated deep proficiency with Big Data processing technologies (Hadoop, Spark,HBase, Cassandra, other NO SQL solutions) 
 Experience in building data pipelines and analysis tools using Java (not limited to J2EE), Scala, Python 
 An understanding of databases and large-scale data processing frameworks 
 Experience building large-scale server-side systems with distributed processing algorithms. 
 Strong problem solving skills 
 Ability to learn new languages, tools, and techniques as needed to meet project requirements 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 

 Desired Skills:  
 

 C#/.NET, Java EE, Ruby or other object oriented programming language 
 Familiarity with map data 
 Familiarity with real-time streaming distributed data processing systems. 
 Development experience with Linux or Unix 
 Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud hosting provider 
 

 Education/Experience Required:  
 Minimum 5 years Programming work experience; 
 Four year degree from an accredited university with a Bachelor’s degree in the field of Computer Science or related field, and/or equivalent work experience.

 Hadoop, Spark,HBase, Cassandra, other NO SQL solutions,C#/.NET, Java EE, Ruby.
